title: English Vocabulary Builder B1.2 — Perspectives: American English Vocabulary and Pronunciat
description: English Vocabulary Builder B1.2: Perspectives is for intermediate learners who want to expand vocabulary while understanding how natural American English really sounds. Unlike a standard word-list book, every key word includes easy pronunciation respelling . You learn the spelling, meaning, and how to say the word clearly—without IPA or a special phonetic alphabet. Learn Vocabulary and Pronunciation Together English spelling often hides pronunciation. This series makes sound visible. CAPITAL letters show stress, hyphens divide syllables, and consistent respelling helps you pronounce unfamiliar words confidently. Each reading appears in three layers : Interlinear pronunciation for careful word-by-word speech Plain English for normal spelling Connected speech for phrases as they sound in natural conversation What Makes Book 7 Different? Book 6 introduced sound assimilation —sounds changing because of neighboring sounds. Book 7 focuses on elision : sounds that disappear in fluent speech. t/d elision: next day → neks-DAY; old man → ohl-MAN H-dropping: tell him → TE-lim; give her → GI-ver Disappearing syllables: probably → PRAH-blee; comfortable → KUMF-ter-buul These patterns explain why fast English can seem to “swallow” sounds. Once you know what disappears, connected speech becomes easier to recognize and produce naturally. What You Will Learn This B1.2 volume contains 18 chapters and about 830 essential words . Topics include culture, art, literature, the environment, education, science, technology, personal values, change, and different points of view. Grammar includes the full tense range , an introduction to the passive voice , the third conditional , complete reported speech , and modals of deduction such as must, might, could , and can't .
